name: Bathing-water quality by year
summary: The official yearly quality label of every bathing site in Cyprus, from 2004 to 2025. History only: it is not a statement about the water today.

el.name: Ποιότητα νερών κολύμβησης ανά έτος
el.summary: Η επίσημη ετήσια κατάταξη ποιότητας κάθε σημείου κολύμβησης στην Κύπρο, από το 2004 έως το 2025. Μόνο ιστορικό: δεν λέει πώς είναι το νερό σήμερα.

publisher.name: European Environment Agency (EEA) and DG Environment

licence.attribution: European Environment Agency and DG Environment, bathing water status 1990-2025

update.note: One release a year, months after the season ends. The server reads a reviewed copy kept in context/ and never fetches a newer one by itself.

quality.uncertainty: A label for a whole season from samples taken over several seasons. It is not a measurement of today and not a count of bacteria.
known_issues: The rules for the labels changed over the years, so 2004 and 2025 are not fully comparable
The list of sites changes: a site missing in one year was not necessarily closed

restrictions: Credit the EEA and DG Environment (CC BY 4.0) wherever this is shown, and say that it was filtered to Cyprus
Never show it as safety advice for today, never as a score or an average

use_for: How a beach was labelled in a past season
How many sites were in the list each year
not_for: Whether the water is safe today
Comparing with our sensors or any measurement

notes: Reviewed, frozen release eea_t_bathing-water-status_p_1990-2025_v01_r00 (published 2 June 2026), prepared in the research handoff of 13 November 2026 and kept as context/bathing-water-history.json (hash in context/manifest.json). Read by context.js. The brain does not read this layer (x_reads).
